summary.intent: Remove the pre-mode guard on the release-PR path (callisto) so release PRs work during prerelease cycles, then verify it via review and the full CI gate and finalize docs.
summary.outcome: A subagent review found no correctness defects. All five gate recipes (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, ci) exited 0. The reviewer's wording fixes were applied to docs/releasing.md and .changeset/silent-ravens-climb.md and committed. The test-coverage suggestions were not acted on.

repo: Gate recipes are run via `just` (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, ci); CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 is used to limit parallelism.
The release PR path in pre mode works for Changesets v2 (changesets already in pre.json are excluded) and v3 (notes already in .changeset/pre/ are excluded), so a cycle with nothing new is a noop.
After `callisto pre exit`, every prerelease package gets a patch bump, so the stable release goes through the release PR.
E165 release-commit verification tolerates the v3 archive move (delete .changeset/x.md, add .changeset/pre/x.md) because is_changeset_path strips `pre/`.
The action script's commit-plan uses `git diff --cached --no-renames`, so archive moves reach createCommitOnBranch as delete plus add.
The generated workflows run the version-pr job alongside package/execute on the merge push, which may race with the new release tag existing.

code.finding: `decide` bases create/noop on plan_version(...).bumps, which is what makes pre mode work once the guard is removed.
require_recorded_changesets_consumed compares the decision's consumed list with the changesets the commit deletes. Consumed paths include archived notes' original paths (:85-92).
Archive and pre.json deletions are allowed paths (:704-715), and is_changeset_path strips `pre/` (:722).
After pre exit, prerelease packages get a patch bump.
The version-pr job runs alongside package/execute on the merge push, which may race with release tag creation.

friction: The first python edit left the changeset wording needing a follow-up sed to fix the phrasing ("keeps its release PR running" became "keeps a release PR open").
The stale-PR sentence in docs/releasing.md contradicted itself ("not caught" followed by "still refuses") and needed rewording.
open_items: Add a test in crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_pr_pre_cycle_tests.rs for a `release-trigger = "auto"` package in pre mode (next -beta.N, and noop when nothing is new).
Add a test for the `update` path with an open release PR in pre mode; the snapshot never has an open PR.
Check whether the version-pr vs. release tag race can re-infer just-released commits for auto-trigger packages and open a spurious PR; unconfirmed.
